zh.title: 讓老師的理解，
zh.sub: 孩子需要支持，老師也需要方法
zh.lead: 支持教育工作者，在有限資源下成為學生的一雙手。
zh.proof: 100+ 教育工作者參與，97.7% 對工作坊感到滿意。研究機構：香港理工大學

intro.p1: 由引導師帶領反思與交流，從角色體驗與合作搭建，讓抽象概念變成親身體驗。
intro.p2: 工作坊經教育工作者反覆試玩，並按真實課室情況優化；完成後以多次評估追蹤變化。

video.note: 影片位置：請在 CMS 填入影片網址（video.src）。

items.p: 學會從行為出發，讀懂孩子未說出口的需要。
在工作坊中反覆演練，找到能讓學生感到被理解的回應。
全校團隊用同一套說法談情緒與支援，協作更順暢。
把工作坊所學帶回校園，並透過指南持續反思。

zh.band: 更理解孩子，更有信心支援

en.title: Let teachers’ understanding
en.sub: Children need support. Teachers need tools too.
en.lead: Support teachers to become students’ “supporting hand” under limited resources.
en.proof: 100+ educators participated, 97.7% satisfied with the workshop. Research institute: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University

intro.h: Training that starts with lived experience
intro.p1: Facilitator-guided reflection and exchange, with role experience and collaborative building, turn abstract concepts into lived experience.
intro.p2: The workshop was repeatedly play-tested with educators and refined for real classrooms, then tracked through multiple assessments.

video.note: Video placeholder: add the video URL in the CMS (video.src).

items.p: Learn to start from behaviour and read the needs a child hasn’t put into words.
Rehearse in the workshop to find replies that help a student feel understood.
A whole-school team that talks about emotions and support in the same way works together more easily.
Take what you practised back to campus and keep reflecting with the practice guide.

en.band: Better understanding of children. Greater confidence in providing support.
